Each class must be accounted for as present, explicitly not applicable with source/reason, missing, or failed; unknown is not silently treated as not applicable.

condition_crosswalk.preserved_meaning: raw logs/PR/test-CI/audit finding source types, completion boundary, knowledge-only promotion, no progress mixing; current PO restricts harness memory to Codex/Claude collaboration and no over-retention.
condition_crosswalk.meaning_difference: Old literal Claude Code/Codex actor and DB continuation are not implemented as old architecture: proposed target is current Codex/Claude collaboration episode and L2-019 continuation. Scope and formal successor remain unconfirmed; requirement candidate remains unadopted.
condition_crosswalk.positive_oracle: Two separate controls: A provides one PR target revision, two raw-log spans, a terminal test/CI result, and an audit finding; all four classes are present and every summary claim maps to exact source/revision/span. Continuation retains result, unfinished finding, and resume position; only distinct durable knowledge may be handed off separately. B provides explicit existing operation/scope evidence that no PR was created; only the PR class is marked not applicable with that evidence, while the other three classes are accounted for. No missing/failed class is a positive control.
condition_crosswalk.negative_oracle: Silently omit any class; treat unknown as false/not applicable; omit a selected source/span; change a source revision; leave a summary claim untraceable; transfer progress or the whole summary to durable knowledge; promote rules/preferences or unverified findings; resume from provider memory only; or fall back to a prior/provider summary after a selected-source read failure. Reject or retain incomplete/unknown with unfinished obligations.
condition_crosswalk.not_seen: No bounded retention duration, numerical compression ratio, fixed source count, storage/DB schema, fixed algorithm, or runtime performance target in selected source; none added.
condition_crosswalk.scope_limit: Not-applicable is accepted only with explicit source/operation-scope evidence, as in control B. A class/source that is merely unselected or unconnected remains unobserved and is not classified as reference-only.
